verdict.rationale: Semgrep explicitly documents SAST scanning with taint tracking designed to catch injection and XSS bugs (semgrep-docs-41, semgrep-docs-58), backed by a CLI scan workflow (semgrep-docs-19, semgrep-docs-27) and corroborated by community use for security lint rules including injection detection (semgrep-comm-1, semgrep-comm-7). Missing for 10: independent benchmark data on vulnerability-class detection rates, and community reports show simple evasions (e.g., function aliasing) can bypass naive rules (semgrep-comm-6, semgrep-comm-10), indicating real-world efficacy caveats.
